message:
You know me — I like to be gloriously over-prepared for just about anything! So when it comes to power outages, I’ve got my trusty toolkit of tips and strategies ready to roll. I recently found a fantastic resource that lays out everything you might need for those unexpected moments when the lights go out. From food storage to keeping the kiddos entertained, it’s all there, making it super easy to stay calm and collected.

Remember, a little prep goes a long way in keeping the stress at bay. What’s your go-to tip for handling a blackout? Let’s share our wisdom! 🌟
